about: The buildings that aren't in a village: the cabins, by id, in the rows a mod edits (docs/design/builders.md section 4; Buildings.cs). Their cells stand as the valley was baked, in "built" (spans [y, x0, x1, ...] from "at", by terrain), and "site" is where ValleyShape puts each in metres, with the way its door faces. Village buildings are read from world/villages.json and the cells, with ids like Hollowmere#4. Append, never insert: an id is its place in this list.
